services.name: Class Schedule and Descriptions
services.desc: For our adults looking to stay in shape, or get in shape we have the perfect class to offer. Absolute FIT is a 45 mins circuit style weight training class with a 10-15 min MET-CON at the end. ​Our Sports Performance Academy will consist of 2 classes; Absolute Strength and Absolute Speed. Each class will provide our athletes the tools to reach their highest potential. Each athlete will be trained as an "athlete". The athlete will learn to move dynamically in space, as well as being challenged mentally and physically. These classes will be offered around school breaks. ©2020 by Absolute Strength Sports Performance and Fitness. Proudly created with

blurb: Kyle has 10+ years of experience as a collegiate strength and conditioning coach, coaching at the division 1 and division 2 levels. Helping athletes become All-Americans and All Conference selections. His stops included working with athletes at USF, Kent State University, West Point Army, and Notre Dame College.
